text:
marta: Heads up, CI started failing after we made the JS SDK ESM-first. Only failing on linux runners, mac dev machines fine.

marta: Job error:
```
Error [ERR_REQUIRE_ESM]: Must use import to load ES Module: /work/monorepo/packages/sdk/dist/index.js
    at Module._extensions..js (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:1108:13)
    at Module.load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:935:32)
    at Module.require (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:956:19)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/work/monorepo/packages/service/tests/client.test.ts:6:1)
```

samir: Likely Node mismatch in docker image or test runner not inlining deps. Is the linux runner using Node 16?

marta: Yes our legacy docker runner is Node 16. Need to pin to 18.

lucy: Two fixes: (A) For Vitest add deps.inline: ['@redwood/sdk']; (B) For Jest either enable ESM transforms (extensionsToTreatAsEsm) or provide a small CJS shim via package.exports require entry.

ryan: Also mocks behave differently under ESM. jest.mock hoisting doesn't apply; use jest.unstable_mockModule or vi.mock with async factories. Top-level side-effects in dist can cause real impl to run before the mock is registered.

marta: Example flake (Vitest):
```ts
import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'
vi.mock('@redwood/sdk', () => ({ createClient: () => ({ request: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ ok: true }) }) }))
```
Sometimes CI resolves real impl.

samir: Proposed short-term actions: pin CI to Node 18, add vitest deps.inline, set NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules for Jest jobs, and add a temporary dist/index.cjs shim in package.exports. Also audit SDK for top-level side-effects.

marta: Please open a PR and add a changelog note: "ESM-first SDK may require test runner updates". Tag me.

eng-ci-bot: CI:unit-tests:linux failed 2 times in last 3 hours.

lucy: Add a devex playbook note with examples for vi.mock/jest.unstable_mockModule and the recommended jest/vitest configs.

ryan: Once PR lands run a full GH actions matrix (linux/mac/windows) to validate.

marta: Thanks — assigning @samir to follow up.
